meta.name: debugging
meta.description: MUST USE for any real runtime debugging across ANY language or binary — crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, stuck processes, memory leaks, async misbehavior, unexplained timing, reverse engineering. Runs a hypothesis-driven loop: form ≥3 hypotheses, investigate in parallel, after 2 failed rounds spawn Oracles from orthogonal angles, confirm root cause, lock with a failing test, fix minimally, QA by actually USING the system, scrub artifacts. The actual HOW lives in `references/` — READ THEM. Triggers: 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer', 'pwndbg', 'gdb', 'lldb', 'node inspect', 'pdb', 'dlv', 'delve', 'rust-gdb', 'set a breakpoint', 'context window exploded', 'why is the response empty', 'why is this happening', 'trace this bug', 'reproduce and fix', 'silent failure', 'HTTP 200 but empty', 'why did it stop', 'inspect the binary', 'playwright', 'flaky test', 'fails intermittently', 'passes in isolation', 'only fails in CI'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位并修复程序崩溃、卡死与行为异常,让软件恢复稳定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常遇到程序崩溃、卡死或诡异行为却不知如何排查
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix crashes, hangs, and odd behaviors in your software
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get crashes, freezes, or weird errors and want to fix them

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 排障时以真实运行状态为准,不凭读代码猜测;先形成 3 个以上假设并同时验证,连续失败两轮后换角度重查,找到根因,先写失败测试再最小修复,最后真跑一遍确认修好并清理调试临时文件。
howto.when: 任何真实运行时调试都会触发:程序崩溃、卡住、静默失败,或你说“debug this”“why is X not working”“attach a debugger”等调试请求。

say.text: 帮我查一下为什么这个 Python 服务内存一直涨,然后修好它。
say.note: Claude 会先看真实内存状态,再形成假设定位泄漏。

say.text: 这个接口返回 200 但 body 是空的,怎么回事?
say.note: Claude 会实际请求并跟踪响应,定位静默失败原因。

say.text: 这个测试单独跑能过,一到 CI 就挂,帮我查。
say.note: Claude 会按间歇性故障流程排查 CI 环境差异。

howto.what_en: Claude debugs from observed runtime state, not guesses. Tests 3+ hypotheses in parallel, spawns Oracles after 2 failed rounds, confirms root cause with a failing test, fixes minimally, runs the system to verify, cleans up artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any real runtime debugging: crashes, hangs, silent failures, or requests like 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'attach a debugger'.

say_en.text: Why does my Python service's memory keep growing? Fix it.
say_en.note: Claude checks live memory state to locate the leak.

say_en.text: This endpoint returns 200 but empty body. Why?
say_en.note: Claude traces the real response to find the silent failure.

say_en.text: This test passes in isolation but fails in CI. Investigate.
say_en.note: Claude uses flaky-test triage to narrow environment causes.
